description_en: Queries the status and result of an image detection task created by CreateImageDetectionTask
description_zh: 查询通过CreateImageDetectionTask创建的图片检测任务的状态和结果
name: GetImageDetectionTaskResult

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotency of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一。`ClientToken` 只支持 ASCII 字符，且不能超过 64 个字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The task ID returned by CreateImageDetectionTask
parameters.name: task_id

Code.description_en: The business error code. The value "OK" is returned when the request succeeds
Code.description_zh: 业务错误码。请求成功时返回 `"OK"`

DetectMode.description_en:
The detection mode that was actually executed. Valid values:
aigc: AIGC only.
tamper: tamper detection.

This field is returned only when Status is succeeded
DetectMode.description_zh:
实际执行的检测模式。取值：
aigc（仅 AIGC）
tamper（篡改检测）

仅在 `Status` 为 `succeeded` 时返回

HttpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code. The value 200 is returned when the request succeeds
HttpStatusCode.description_zh: HTTP 状态码。请求成功时返回 `200`

Labels.description_en: The list of detection result labels. This field is returned only when Status is succeeded and AIGC detection is included. The label values and confidence ranges vary depending on DetectMode. In aigc mode, AIGC generation identification labels are returned (see the table below). In tamper mode, aigc/aips labels are returned (confidence range: 0 to 1)
Labels.description_zh: 检测结果标签列表。仅在 Status 为 succeeded 且包含 AIGC 检测时返回。标签取值与置信度范围随 DetectMode 不同：aigc 模式返回 AIGC 生成鉴别标签（见下表），tamper 模式返回 aigc / aips 标签（置信度 0~1）

Confidence.description_en: The confidence level. Value range: 0 to 1

Label.description_en: The detection label. When DetectMode is aigc, valid values are: risk_aigc (the image is suspected to be AIGC-generated), risk_fake (the image is suspected to be a composite image), risk_edit (the image is suspected to be AI-edited). When DetectMode is tamper, valid values are: aigc (AIGC detection score), aips (AI post-processing detection score)
Label.description_zh: 检测标签。DetectMode=aigc 时取值：risk_aigc（图片疑似 AIGC 生成）、risk_fake（图片疑似为合成图片）、risk_edit（图片疑似为 AI 编辑图片）；DetectMode=tamper 时取值：aigc（AIGC 检测得分）、aips（AI 后处理检测得分）

Message.description_en: The additional information. The value "success" is returned when the request succeeds. The error message is returned when the task fails. This field is returned only when Status is failed
Message.description_zh: 附加信息。请求成功时返回 `"success"`。任务失败时的错误信息。仅在 `Status` 为 `failed` 时返回

Status.description_en:
The task status. Valid values:
pending: waiting.
running: in progress.
succeeded: completed.
failed: failed
Status.description_zh:
任务状态。取值：
`pending`（等待中）
`running`（执行中）
`succeeded`（已完成）
`failed`（失败）

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful

AiWatermark.description_en: The AI visible watermark. This field is returned only in large model mode. It is empty in small model mode
AiWatermark.description_zh: AI 明水印。仅大模型模式产出，小模型模式为空
AiWatermark.title_en: AI明水印(仅大模型 llm_result.AIGC检测分析.AI明水印)
AiWatermark.title_zh: AI明水印(仅大模型 llm_result.AIGC检测分析.AI明水印)

BaseResults.description_en: The basic algorithm detection results, including multi-dimensional detection scores and risk labels
BaseResults.description_zh: 基础算法检测结果，包含多维度检测得分与风险标签

Risk.title_en: 维度风险标签(中文，如高风险/无风险)
Risk.title_zh: 维度风险标签(中文，如高风险/无风险)

Score.description_en: The AIGC detection score. Value range: 0 to 1. A higher value indicates a greater likelihood of AI generation
Score.description_zh: AIGC 检测得分，范围 0~1，值越高表示 AI 生成可能性越大

Desc.description_en: The AI post-processing detection result description
Desc.description_zh: AI 后处理检测结果描述

Risk.description_en: The local PS/AI editing dimension risk label
Risk.description_zh: 局部 PS/AI 编辑维度风险标签
Risk.title_en: 维度风险标签(中文，如高风险/无风险)
Risk.title_zh: 维度风险标签(中文，如高风险/无风险)

Score.description_en: The AI post-processing detection score. Value range: 0 to 1. A higher value indicates a greater likelihood of AI post-processing
Score.description_zh: AI 后处理检测得分，范围 0~1，值越高表示 AI 后处理可能性越大

Desc.description_en: The PS tamper localization result description
Desc.description_zh: PS 篡改定位结果描述

Bbox.description_en: The bounding box coordinates of the tampered region, in the format `[x1, y1, x2, y2]`
Bbox.description_zh: 篡改区域边界框坐标，格式为 `[x1, y1, x2, y2]`

items.description_en: The bounding box coordinates of the tampered region

Score.description_en: The tamper confidence of the region. Value range: 0 to 1
Score.description_zh: 该区域的篡改置信度，范围 `0~1`

Desc.description_zh: 翻拍/复印检测结果描述

Risk.description_zh: 翻拍/复印维度风险标签
Risk.title_en: 维度风险标签(中文，如高风险/无风险)
Risk.title_zh: 维度风险标签(中文，如高风险/无风险)

Score.description_en: The recapture/copy detection score. Value range: 0 to 1. A higher value indicates a greater likelihood of recapture or copying
Score.description_zh: 翻拍/复印检测得分，范围 0~1，值越高表示翻拍/复印可能性越大

FinalConclusion.example: 核验到元数据分析结果为高风险
FinalConclusion.title_en: 最终结论(小模型 base_results.merge_risk.summary / 大模型 llm_result.最终研判.最终结论)
FinalConclusion.title_zh: 最终结论(小模型 base_results.merge_risk.summary / 大模型 llm_result.最终研判.最终结论)

LlmResult.description_en: The comprehensive analysis result from the large language model
LlmResult.example: 该图片经检测存在AI生成痕迹，AIGC检测得分0.95，建议进一步核实图片来源。

MetadataAiFlag.description_en: The metadata AI flag. This field is always returned
MetadataAiFlag.description_zh: 元数据 AI 标识。必有
MetadataAiFlag.title_en: 元数据AI标识(小模型 base_results.metadata.risk / 大模型 llm_result.AIGC检测分析.元数据AI标识)
MetadataAiFlag.title_zh: 元数据AI标识(小模型 base_results.metadata.risk / 大模型 llm_result.AIGC检测分析.元数据AI标识)

MetadataAiSource.description_en: The source of the metadata AI flag. This field is returned only in large model mode. It is empty in small model mode
MetadataAiSource.description_zh: 元数据 AI 标识来源。仅大模型模式产出，小模型模式为空
MetadataAiSource.title_en: 元数据AI标识来源(仅大模型)
MetadataAiSource.title_zh: 元数据AI标识来源(仅大模型)

RiskLevel.description_en: The determination result. This field is always returned
RiskLevel.title_en: 判定结果(小模型 base_results.merge_risk.risk / 大模型 llm_result.风险分级.综合风险)
RiskLevel.title_zh: 判定结果(小模型 base_results.merge_risk.risk / 大模型 llm_result.风险分级.综合风险)
